title: Car Wrapping Service in Delta & Greater Vancouver
description: Car wraps and colour-change vinyl wrapping at AK Wraps & Customs in Delta. Compare finishes, preparation and coverage, then request a vehicle-specific quote.
intro: A vinyl wrap changes your vehicle’s appearance with a new colour or finish. At our Delta studio, we plan each project around the vehicle, its existing paint and the look you want.

sections.title: Choose your finish and coverage
sections.text: Tell us whether you want a full colour change or accents such as a roof, hood or trim. Bring reference photos and we can discuss film choices, coverage and details before quoting.

sections.title: Preparation matters
sections.text: Existing paint condition, repairs and the shape of each panel affect the installation. Share any repainting, peeling clear coat or damaged panels when requesting your quote so we can assess preparation needs.

sections.title: Vinyl wrap or coloured PPF?
sections.text: Vinyl is an appearance-focused option. If your priority is both a colour change and protection against everyday road debris, ask us to compare coloured paint protection film with vinyl for your build.

sections.title: How to choose a high-quality car wrap
sections.text: Compare close-up photos of edges, seams and complex panels, not only distant finished-car photos. Ask which film will be used, how existing paint will be assessed, what trim removal is included and how aftercare is handled. A useful quote identifies the coverage and preparation, not just a starting price.

sections.title: Gloss, satin or matte?
sections.text: Gloss reflects more light; satin offers a softer sheen; matte gives a low-sheen appearance. Specialty and colour-shift films change with viewing angle and light. Review physical samples with us before selecting a finish: a photograph or screen cannot reproduce every colour accurately.

sections.title: What your consultation should cover
sections.text: Confirm the film, covered panels and whether door returns, trim removal or existing wrap removal are included. We will discuss your paint condition and desired finish before agreeing on the scope. Bring reference images, and review our documented builds for examples.

faq.question: How much does a car wrap cost?
faq.answer: We quote for your vehicle, chosen film, coverage and preparation needs. Send the year, make, model and desired finish for an estimate.

faq.question: Can I see your previous wrap projects?
faq.answer: Our gallery includes actual AK Wraps builds, including the Chrysler 300 Hellcat. Explore the project photos and listed services before planning your own.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: Our vinyl wraps include a two-year installation warranty. Contact us for the written terms, exclusions and care requirements for your chosen installation before booking.

faq.question: How do I choose the best wrap shop for my car?
faq.answer: Look for relevant completed work, a clear written scope, an explanation of the film and preparation, and product-specific care and warranty terms. Ask to see work on similar body shapes and discuss the finish you expect before comparing quotes.

faq.question: Where is your shop, and can I visit from another city?
faq.answer: Our shop is at 6165 BC-17A, Delta, BC V4K 4E2. We welcome Greater Vancouver drivers at this location. Contact us to agree on scope, drop-off and collection before travelling; we do not claim a branch in every city.

faq.question: What happens after I enquire?
faq.answer: We review your vehicle and goals, discuss preparation and material options, and confirm scope, pricing and timing with you. Ask for the selected product’s warranty and care instructions before booking. Sending the form does not reserve an appointment.

title: Car PPF & Paint Protection Film Installation in Delta, BC
description: Compare full front and full body car PPF, windshield protection and ceramic coating at our Delta studio. Explore Tesla PPF options and request a Greater Vancouver quote.
intro: Paint protection film (PPF) is a transparent or coloured film fitted to painted body panels. At our Delta studio, you can choose protection for the front of your car or a full-body PPF wrap.

sections.title: Plan protection around how you drive
sections.text: Discuss the panels that matter most to you, including the hood, bumper, fenders and other exposed areas, or ask about full vehicle coverage. We will confirm a suitable scope and film before quoting.

sections.title: Clear or coloured film
sections.text: Clear PPF keeps the underlying colour visible. Coloured PPF combines a new look with protective film. Ask to compare available finishes and maintenance requirements for your vehicle.

sections.title: Start with the paint condition
sections.text: Film does not repair damaged paint. Tell us about existing chips, scratches or repainted panels so we can discuss whether preparation or repair is needed before installation.

sections.title: What to compare in a high-quality PPF installation
sections.text: Ask for the exact film, covered panels, edge treatment and preparation included in the quote. Inspect completed work for finish clarity and visible edges, and discuss how complex panels are handled. Confirm aftercare, inspection arrangements and the distinction between film warranty and workmanship coverage.

sections.title: Full front, high-impact or full body?
sections.text: A front-focused installation concentrates on exposed front panels; high-impact coverage can extend to other vulnerable areas; full-body coverage has a broader scope. Package names alone do not define coverage. Confirm the exact panel list, edge treatment and exclusions in your quote.

sections.title: PPF and ceramic coating serve different purposes
sections.text: PPF is a physical film designed to help protect the surfaces it covers. Ceramic coating is a surface treatment that can make maintenance easier. It is not a substitute for film against stone impacts. Discuss whether a compatible combination fits your goals.

faq.question: How long does installation take, and when can I book?
faq.answer: Send us your vehicle details and preferred dates. We’ll review paint preparation, coverage and coating cure time, then confirm pricing, drop-off and pickup with you before booking.

faq.question: What is PPF for a car, and what does self-healing mean?
faq.answer: Car PPF is paint protection film: a physical layer that helps shield paint from gravel and small chips. Warmth can help faint marks in a self-healing topcoat fade. Deep cuts and heavy impacts can still damage the film or paint.

faq.question: Why polish the paint before applying PPF?
faq.answer: Clear film shows the finish underneath. Polishing reduces haze and fine swirls before installation. We assess deeper scratches, chips or previous repairs separately.

faq.question: PPF vs ceramic coating: what does each protect?
faq.answer: A PPF wrap helps absorb small impacts. Ceramic coating helps water bead and makes the surface easier to wash. Our full-body package combines the two, with Gtechniq ceramic coating applied over the film.

faq.question: What does full front PPF cover compared with full body PPF?
faq.answer: For a full front PPF quote, discuss the bumper, full hood, front fenders and mirror caps. Full-body coverage extends to painted doors, roof and rear panels. We confirm the exact panel list for your vehicle. Windshield PPF is a separate film for the glass and is quoted as an add-on.

faq.question: What does the 10-year PPF warranty cover?
faq.answer: Our PPF includes a ten-year warranty covering both the film and installation. Contact us for the written terms, exclusions and care requirements for your chosen installation before booking.

faq.question: When and how should I wash my vehicle after installation?
faq.answer: At pickup, ask for the first-wash date for your film and coating. Once they’re ready, follow the supplied care instructions, wash gently and avoid directing a pressure washer at film edges.

faq.question: What records should I keep for an ICBC claim?
faq.answer: Keep your itemized installation invoice and photos showing the covered panels. If the film is damaged, ask your ICBC claims representative what documentation they need before arranging replacement.

faq.question: How do I compare film brands and quotes from local PPF installers?
faq.answer: If you are comparing STEK PPF, 3M paint protection film or another brand, ask for the exact series on each quote. Compare panel coverage, edge finishing, aftercare and written warranty terms. Contact our Delta studio to confirm availability for your preferred film.

faq.question: Where is your shop, and can I visit from another city?
faq.answer: Our shop is at 6165 BC-17A, Delta, BC V4K 4E2. We welcome Greater Vancouver drivers at this location. Contact us to agree on scope, drop-off and collection before travelling; we do not claim a branch in every city.

faq.question: How do I get a Tesla PPF quote?
faq.answer: Send the model, year, paint condition and panels you want protected. For a Model 3 or Model Y, for example, ask for full front and full body pricing on the same vehicle so you can compare costs.

faq.question: Should I choose matte PPF or a vinyl wrap?
faq.answer: Matte PPF combines a low-gloss finish with paint protection film. A vinyl wrap is typically chosen for a colour or styling change. Tell us the look you want and whether stone-chip protection is a priority so we can discuss suitable materials.

title: Car Window Tinting in Delta & Greater Vancouver
description: Car window tinting at AK Wraps & Customs in Delta for Greater Vancouver drivers. Compare film options, window coverage and existing tint removal.
intro: Window tint changes the appearance and comfort of your vehicle’s glass. We help you discuss shade and film choices at our Delta studio, with coverage agreed before installation.

sections.title: Select the right film for your goals
sections.text: Let us know whether appearance, privacy or cabin comfort matters most. Available films have different properties, so we will discuss product specifications rather than promise the same performance from every option.

sections.title: Tell us about existing tint
sections.text: Include whether your vehicle already has tint and whether it is bubbling, damaged or needs removal. Existing film and window coverage affect the work involved and your estimate.

sections.title: Plan your installation
sections.text: Send your year, make, model and the windows you want assessed. Ask our team to confirm suitable coverage and applicable requirements before choosing a shade.

sections.title: Compare window tint quotes on the same basis
sections.text: Check which windows and film product each quote includes, whether old film removal is needed and which performance claims come from the selected product. Discuss curing, cleaning and applicable requirements before choosing coverage.

sections.title: Comfort, appearance and maintenance
sections.text: Compare the specific film data and agreed windows rather than choosing by shade alone. Ask about existing-film removal, curing and cleaning. Product performance and suitable coverage should be confirmed for your vehicle before installation.

faq.question: Can you match existing tint?
faq.answer: Tell us which windows are already tinted and bring the vehicle for assessment. Appearance can vary with existing glass and film; our team will discuss suitable options.

faq.question: When can I roll the windows down?
faq.answer: Follow the aftercare instructions supplied for your installation. Curing time depends on the film and conditions; our team will explain the recommended care at collection.

title: Ceramic Coating & Paint Correction in Delta & Greater Vancouver
description: Ceramic coating and paint correction at our Delta studio. Compare paint preparation, coating options and aftercare for your Greater Vancouver vehicle.
intro: Paint correction and ceramic coating address different parts of your finish. Correction improves suitable paint defects; a coating is applied to a prepared surface to help maintain the finish. We assess your vehicle before recommending a scope.

sections.title: Assess swirls and light scratches
sections.text: Paint correction uses polishing to improve suitable defects in the clear coat. Results depend on paint condition and remaining material. Deep damage may require a different approach, so we assess it before promising a result.

sections.title: Prepare before coating
sections.text: Cleaning and preparation matter to the final finish. Tell us about previous coatings, repainting and your expectations so we can discuss a suitable preparation and coating package.

sections.title: Care after installation
sections.text: A coating does not eliminate washing or make paint scratch-proof. Our team will explain product-specific curing and maintenance instructions, including how to care for the finish after collection.

sections.title: What makes a useful ceramic coating quote?
sections.text: Look for a clear assessment of the existing paint and the preparation included. Ask which coating is proposed, how curing affects collection and what maintenance is required. Compare polishing and coating as separate parts of the scope so you understand what improves the paint and what helps maintain it.

sections.title: Choose preparation before a durability label
sections.text: A coating is applied over the finish underneath it. Compare the assessment, cleaning and polishing included in each quote, then the selected coating and its care requirements. A stated durability period is not a promise that every scratch, stain or maintenance issue is covered.

faq.question: Does ceramic coating remove scratches?
faq.answer: The coating itself does not remove scratches. Paint correction is a separate preparation process that may improve suitable defects before a coating is applied.

faq.question: How long does the coating last?
faq.answer: Durability depends on the chosen product, preparation, use and maintenance. Ask us for the specific product’s care requirements and any applicable warranty before booking.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
